title: Web/API
description: Explore the Apprentice Portal and work with its prepared HTTP API.

challenges.title: Read the source
challenges.goal: Inspect the homepage source to find a comment and the first flag.
hints: Use the portal preview or curl http://portal:8080/ from this terminal.
HTML comments are present in the source even though the browser does not display them.

challenges.title: What the style hides
challenges.goal: Find the notice hidden by the portal stylesheet.
hints: Inspect styles.css and the HTML element it targets.
CSS changes visibility, not whether text exists in the response.

challenges.title: Ask for the archive
challenges.goal: Discover the API description and JavaScript request clue. Retrieve the training archive using its query parameter and required header.
hints: Read /app.js and GET /api/info on the portal.
curl -H sets a request header. The API description documents the department query parameter.

challenges.title: Dispatch the kit
challenges.goal: Send a supported training-kit action as JSON to the dispatch endpoint.
hints: Read the archive response for the parcel and action values.
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"parcel":"VALUE","action":"VALUE"}' URL sends a JSON body. Check the API’s response status and message.
